entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-03-30
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [dotnet-watch] Ctrl+C does not work on Android (likely mobile) #53634
  • dotnet restore fails with MSB4057 _GetRestoreSettingsPerFramework on macOS arm64 with SDK 10.0.105 #53629
  • `dotnet publish -o .` produces empty assembly - PublishDir glob excludes all source files #53626
  • New files ignored by hot-reload if entire project is inside a hidden folder #53625

Closed

  • `dotnet publish` removes native DLLs on subsequent runs #52151

PullRequests

Created

  • Introduce a property to specify assemblies that should be partially R2R compiled and excluded from a composite image. #53635
    Area-ReadyToRun
  • [release/10.0.2xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #53633
  • Improve SDK resolver error messages when global.json rollforward selects an incompatible SDK #53632
  • [dotnet-watch] Add device selection support #53631
  • Rewrite Copilot instructions and move to AGENTS.md #53630
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Simplify OS/Arch defines #53627
    Area-Infrastructure

Merged

  • Split runfile tests up to improve helix usage #53452
  • Fix "`dotnet publish` removes native DLLs on subsequent runs" #52755
    area-Single-File, Area-NetSDK, sdk-diagnostic-docs-needed

    Area-run-file

    Area-ILLink
